ambient_events: A wall of dark monitors waits, every one of them a window into someone's living room.
The ON AIR lamp above the booth is dark. For now.
Somewhere a cooling fan spins up, spins down, and the room is silent again.
description: A compact television studio and, behind armoured glass, the Emergency Broadcast Room. A production console faces monitors that mirror every tuned screen in the city. Two studio cameras on the floor, one on the rostrum, one pulled wide. A gallery monitor on a swing arm shows what's going out. An ON AIR lamp hangs dark over the booth. The engineering corridor lies to the NORTH.
name: Echelon — Broadcast Complex
